headline: Medical marijuana bill passes the Senate
snippet: Senate passed 22-10 allowing medical cannabis in pill/cream form.

headline: Alabama Senate Approves Medical Marijuana Bill
snippet: Would have made Alabama 34th state to allow medical marijuana. Died without House action.

headline: Medical marijuana bill 'is not about getting high'
snippet: Supporters defended against opponents; limited THC to 75mg/day, prohibited smokable.
